title: Comparison action
statement: For a register $r$, a state $j_C$, a state-valued function $j_{RB}$ on Boolean values, and optional Boolean symbols $a,c$, define the action as follows: if $a=c=\mathrm{none}$, it is $xAct(r,0,-1,j_{RB}(1))$; if $a=c$ and $a$ is present, it is $xAct(r,1,1,j_C)$; and if $a\ne c$, it is $xAct(r,0,-1,j_{RB}(0))$.
hypotheses_covered: A state-valued function jRB on Boolean values
Two optional Boolean symbols a and c
caveat: The supplied statement does not define xAct, so the underlying action cannot be described beyond its arguments.
